row.proto: void Game_PitLane_MoveDownSpline(void *pitlane, uint8_t car, void *teleport_req, bool alt_spline, float dt, bool p6, bool blend, bool p8, bool p9)
row.notes: Pit lane: move car (byte idx param_2) down the pit lane spline. Bails for invalid car/state; samples the pit spline (0x1434e51c0 on self+0xc58 -> position + tangent, 0x144503e70/0x144503c70 transforms), builds the target matrix (0x144632740, 2000.0 limit) and places the car via Game_Place_Vehicle(req=param_3, tag 0x14584366a, prio 3, mtx, ..., blend param_5, flags) or, when blending is wanted (param_7) and the distance is small, Game_Place_VehicleBlend_Thunk (call 0x1434beef3). Optional speed / gear handling via param_8/param_9. (used by vmknolle race-start, red-flag-pit to drive cars through the pit lane) | engine-re 2026-11-17 track round C2 (static): correction: mgr+0xc58 is not the spline but a vehicle-id -> 12-byte entry hash map (0x1434e51c0 = find-or-insert, entries at [mgr+0xc70]). The spline sampled is the per-car Catmull spline [record+0x118] (entry) or [record+0x128] (exit), chosen by param_4 (0x1434be9b2..), located with Ne_Spline_LocateDistance 0x144503e70 (0x1434bea58); record +0xd8 = distance travelled, +0xdc = speed. raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-17 at user request (lane owner review requested)
